title: Coefficient-isomorphism transport of compactification functors and their adjoints
statement:
Let $\Lambda,\Lambda'$ be commutative condensed rings [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and $e:\Lambda\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda'$ a ring-object isomorphism. Use small pro-étale sites in one fixed universe [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. For a scheme $T$, put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$, $\Lambda'_T=p_T^*\Lambda'$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. In the ordinary unbounded module-object derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], let
$$U_T:D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)\longrightarrow D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda')$$
be termwise restriction of scalars along $p_T^*(e^{-1})$ [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. Write $\mathcal C_T=\Dctf(T,\Lambda)$ and $\mathcal C'_T=\Dctf(T,\Lambda')$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $\mathcal L_T$ (respectively $\mathcal L'_T$) be the intersection of all full replete triangulated subcategories of the corresponding ambient derived category containing $\mathcal C_T$ (respectively $\mathcal C'_T$) and closed under ambient small coproducts [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory].

Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism with a fixed compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow Z,p:Z\to Y)$, where $j$ is a quasi-compact open immersion, $p$ is proper and $pj=f$ [sk-def-nagata-sketch-data]. Write $H_\Lambda=Rp_{*,\Lambda}D(j_{!,\Lambda})$ and $H_{\Lambda'}=Rp_{*,\Lambda'}D(j_{!,\Lambda'})$ with the pulled-back module-object convention [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek].

Each $U_T$ is an exact equivalence preserving all small coproducts, identifies $\mathcal C_T$ with $\mathcal C'_T$, and restricts to an exact equivalence $\mathcal L_T\simeq\mathcal L'_T$. There is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$U_YH_\Lambda\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{\Lambda'}U_X.$$
If $H_\Lambda$ carries $\mathcal L_X$ into $\mathcal L_Y$, then $H_{\Lambda'}$ carries $\mathcal L'_X$ into $\mathcal L'_Y$; write $F_\Lambda,F_{\Lambda'}$ for these restrictions. Suppose adjunctions $F_\Lambda\dashv G_\Lambda$ and $F_{\Lambda'}\dashv G_{\Lambda'}$ are given, with counits $\varepsilon_\Lambda,\varepsilon_{\Lambda'}$. The left comparison $a:U_YF_\Lambda\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{\Lambda'}U_X$ has a unique counit-compatible right comparison
$$b:U_XG_\Lambda\xrightarrow{\sim}G_{\Lambda'}U_Y,$$
characterized, for $N\in\mathcal L_Y$, by
$$\varepsilon_{\Lambda',U_YN}\circ F_{\Lambda'}(b_N)\circ a_{G_\Lambda N}=U_Y(\varepsilon_{\Lambda,N}).$$
In particular $G_\Lambda(\mathcal C_Y)\subseteq\mathcal C_X$ if and only if $G_{\Lambda'}(\mathcal C'_Y)\subseteq\mathcal C'_X$.
